quote: In 1946, Stanislaw Ulam asked whether there exists a set of points at rational distances from each other that forms a dense subset of the Euclidean plane.
note: The problem is named after both Erdős and Ulam, though it was Ulam who posed the question in 1946. It was inspired by earlier work with Erdős on rational distance sets.
